title: TreeQN and ATreeC: Differentiable Tree-Structured Models for Deep Reinforcement Learning

Q1.quote: We evaluate TreeQN and ATreeC in a simple box-pushing environment, as well as on the subset of nine Atari environments that Oh et al. (2017) use to evaluate VPN.

Q2.quote: We propose a new tree-structured neural network architecture to address the aforementioned problems.

Q3.quote: All experiments use RMSProp (Tieleman & Hinton, 2012) with a learning rate of 1e-4, a decay of α = 0.99, and ε = 1e-5.

Q4.quote: The learning rate was tuned coarsely by running DQN on the Seaquest environment, and kept the same for all subsequent experiments (box-pushing and Atari).
